changes: Implemented the review-escalation DONE gate: direct decision-doc edits are diagnostic only, first-review countable findings trigger escalation, host verdict binding is stricter, and explicit degraded 3x1 fallback is supported as lower assurance.
usage: Use review_escalation_status to see the actual DONE escalation state, decision_doc_quorum_check for decision-doc diagnostics, review_escalation_fallback_set for explicit degraded 3x1 fallback, and autopilot_review_submit for bound host verdict evidence.
expectedOutcome: A zero-finding decision-doc audit no longer fails DONE just because a decision doc changed; if the first REVIEW round records at least two countable reviewer problems, DONE requires full 3x2 or explicit degraded 3x1 evidence.
actualTranscript: npm test passed through lattice validate with 17/17 verification intents covered. review_escalation_status now reports required:true and ok:true for B-59a6 with assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host after three local single-host verdict rounds and explicit fallback B-59a6:REF-mqf3y1s0. decision_doc_quorum_check reports decision-doc changes are diagnostic only.
outcomeDiff: Expected behavior matches actual runtime. The only difference is this story itself triggered escalation during REVIEW because F-001 and F-002 were verified high first-round findings, so final DONE evidence uses explicit degraded 3x1 rather than ordinary-review/no-escalation.
limitations: Local degraded 3x1 is lower assurance and does not prove full 3x2, Authority receipt completion, authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, or productionDone.
pitfalls: Do not interpret decision_doc_quorum_check as a DONE blocker. Use review_escalation_status for the gate and keep degraded-single-host distinct from full-3x2.
